name: Odyssey Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Odyssey Corporation Ltd does trading of goods, trading in shares, selling of film rights and consultancy[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company was engaged in corporate finance and advisory services. It used to be an NBFC but it submitted application to surrender NBFC license and the same is in process to receive approval from concerned authority. At present, it is into development, global sourcing, distribution, aiding local trading & production of manufacturing & processing services, financing, managing of business activities, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.35 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.18% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.7.49 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -5.28%
Working capital days have increased from 609 days to 960 days
